name: veterinary_clinic_system_038_controlled_dea_schedule_backfill
instruction: Regulatory backfill: every medication with is_controlled_substance=true must carry the correct DEA schedule in dea_schedule. Any controlled row missing dea_schedule must be fixed using the schedule that the OTHER rows for the same drug_name already use (the clinic's existing classifications are authoritative). If no other row for that drug exists, look up the drug's current DEA schedule online. Non-controlled rows must not gain a dea_schedule. Add field schedule_fixed='<batch_code>' to each row you change.

success_criteria.summary: From snapshot: controlled rows with missing/empty dea_schedule -> expected schedule = modal schedule among snapshot rows with same drug_name (fallback: known map Buprenorphine V, Tramadol IV, Ketamine III, Alprazolam IV). Assert exact fix + tag; all other rows byte-identical; count 20.
